doc.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023

title: 'Small Town Blues'
summary: The song reflects the small town she grew up in, leaving it and finding reasons to return.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your tune “Small Town Blues” reflect that time years later?

It did. “Small Town” had a lot to do with the town I grew up in, and it basically talks about that. Coming back to the small town after not being there for a while and realizing I had a hard time sleeping because it was so quiet. Because I had lived in cities after that. And so I talk about that in “Small Town Blues” yeah. And wanting to leave the small town and finding out after I left the small town I had a lot of reasons I needed to get back to that small town. And I did, eventually.
